subject: Resale invoicing & pass-back — clarification on addendum redlines
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@cloudmarketplace.io>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Cc: CloudMarket Legal <legal@cloudmarketplace.io>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 13:12:00 -0800
Subject: Redlines: Marketplace Reseller Addendum — pass-through & invoicing

Hi Connor,

Thanks for the demo last week — we appreciate the quick turnaround on the reseller flow. Attached is our third-pass redline of Redwood's Marketplace Reseller Addendum (CloudMarket_Addendum_Redlines_v3.docx). We focused on a few operational items that need to be resolved before we list: 

- Invoicing & pass-through: CloudMarket wants the marketplace to be the billed party for end-customer usage, and for Redwood to invoice *CloudMarket* (not the end-customer). Our legal team added a pass-through clause for marketplace fees and a carve for taxes.
- Liability / indemnity: clarified limits around reseller-sourced claims (see §7).
- Audit & reporting cadence: asking for quarterly usage reporting and 90-day audit window for billing reconciliation.

Can you confirm Redwood's stance on (1) invoicing to CloudMarket vs end-customer, and (2) whether the pass-through is limited to platform fees or includes third-party taxes? We have a legal contact (cc'd) available for a short call next week if helpful.

Elena
Elena Rossi
Head of Partnerships — CloudMarket Inc.
Attachments: CloudMarket_Addendum_Redlines_v3.docx (docx, 72KB)
From: connor_obrien@redwood.ai <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@cloudmarketplace.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redlines: Marketplace Reseller Addendum — pass-through & invoicing

Elena — thanks for the redline and the clear asks. I reviewed the doc and looped in Marissa (legal) and Karthik (partnerships) for quick alignment. High-level answers below and a proposed compromise attached (Redwood_Marketplace_Addendum_markup.docx).

1) Invoicing: Redwood prefers to invoice the marketplace partner (CloudMarket) for marketplace usage we route via your platform. That keeps billing reconciliation simple for both sides. We can accept CloudMarket as the billed party for marketplace-enabled customers provided CloudMarket agrees to the standard billing and dispute flow (60-day dispute notice, net 30 payment to Redwood).

2) Pass-through scope: Redwood can accept pass-through of marketplace fees that are charged by CloudMarket to end-customers (platform listing fees, take-rate) but we need to exclude taxes collected by local jurisdictions unless explicitly invoiced by Redwood to CloudMarket. In practice: pass-through = partner platform fees; taxes remain subject to local tax laws and invoicing rules.

3) Audit & reporting: quarterly usage reporting is fine; for audit rights we prefer a limited reconciliation audit (once per 12 months, 30-day notice) rather than a broad 90-day audit clause. That helps protect customer data and keeps operational load manageable.

I've flagged §7 (liability) for Marissa — we may need slightly tighter carve-outs for reseller-caused data incidents.

If that matches your team's expectations, we can prepare a redline that narrows the audit window and clarifies pass-through vocabulary. Suggest a 30-minute call Monday 11/23 at 10am PT — happy to send an invite.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_Marketplace_Addendum_markup.docx (docx, 48KB)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redlines: Marketplace Reseller Addendum — pass-through & invoicing

Connor — quick legal read below. I also attached an internal note with suggested language (internal_legal_notes.txt). Key concerns: 

- Liability carve: we should not accept a broad reseller indemnity that flows to Redwood for third-party claims arising from the reseller's config or misuse. Proposed: keep Redwood indemnity narrowly tied to Redwood-delivered code and known vulnerabilities.
- Audit scope: I agree with narrowing audit frequency but suggest a middle ground — allow a targeted 90-day reconciliation *limited to billing items only* with prior redacted customer identifiers and a capped number of audit days per year (2 days). Full access to customer data is a non-starter.
- Data residency: CloudMarket's redline added a requirement to host EU-reseller data in EU-only zones. We should confirm if that applies to all customers or only regulated ones; that can materially change infra cost and we should push to a scope-limited clause.

If we accept the invoicing-to-partner model we should also add: (a) a clause that CloudMarket remains responsible to end-customers for support and refunds processed via marketplace, and (b) a reserve/chargeback process for disputed invoices.

I can join the 11/23 call; propose we finalize language before the DocuSign send.

- Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
Attachments: internal_legal_notes.txt (text, 6KB)

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@cloudmarketplace.io>

Cc: CloudMarket Legal <legal@cloudmarketplace.io>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redlines: Marketplace Reseller Addendum — pass-through & invoicing

Connor / Marissa / Karthik — thanks for the fast read and clear positions. Quick confirmation from our side: 

- CloudMarket accepts being the billed party for marketplace usage and will be responsible for settlement with end-customers. We will adhere to Redwood's dispute windows (60-day) and net 30 payment terms.
- Pass-through: we can narrow our ask to platform fees only (no taxes), and we'll include language that taxes are handled per local laws and invoicing rules.
- Audit: CloudMarket will drop the broad 90-day audit request. We can accept Redwood's proposal for a targeted reconciliation audit, but ask the reconciliation window be 90 days (to align with our internal billing cycle) and limited to billing items only with redacted customer identifiers.

I'll send a final DocuSign packet once you confirm the agreed redline. Here's the proposed DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/CM-4837-sign. Final redline (clean + markup) is in our shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c_redlines_folder

I can join the 11/23 10am PT call to walk through the final tweaks if you want to go live immediately after signing.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Head of Partnerships, CloudMarket Inc.
Attachments: none
